public_rationale: A dated primary study supports the narrower assertion that early ChatGPT produced incorrect scientific explanations. It does not establish that ChatGPT could not reason well enough to make a substantive scientific contribution. Favorable assessments of generated research proposals also caution against that inference, but do not supply a fully verified counterexample. The combined claim remains unsettled.
limitations: Examination performance is an imperfect measure of research capability.
The parasitology study describes input-format and local-knowledge limitations.
Errors and useful reasoning can coexist.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified contemporary research contribution demonstrates sufficient reasoning for substantive scientific work. Correct answers to some examination questions alone do not establish such a contribution.
